The petitioner vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeks quashing of FIR No.87/2015 dated 02.02.2015 registered under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Najafgarh, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Affidavit cum NOC dated 02.08.2023 given by the respondent no.2.
2.
This petition is supported by affidavits of the petitioner and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3. Petitioner as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
CRL.M.C. 7640/2023 page 1 of 2
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/10/2023 at 23:55:25 6.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 27.04.2015.
She states that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr.
